---
package: "openpipeline"
version: "v4.2.0"
title: "singler"
subtitle: "openpipeline v4.2.0"
toc: true
namespace: "Annotate"
description: "SingleR performs reference-based cell type annotation for single-cell RNA-seq data by computing Spearman correlations between test cells and reference samples with known labels, using marker genes to assign the most similar cell type label to each new cell."
type: "module"
latest: "true"
---

### Arguments

Arguments related to the training of and classification with the SingleR model

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--de_n_genes`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The number of differentially expressed genes across labels to be calculated from the reference.
Defaults to 500 * (2/3) ^ log2(N) where N is the number of unique labels when if `--de_method` is set to `classic`,
otherwise, defaults to 10.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Min]{.arg-key} `1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--de_method`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Method to detect differentially expressed genes between pairs of labels.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"classic"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"classic"`, `"t"`, `"wilcox"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--quantile`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The quantile of the correlation distribution to use to compute the score per label.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.8`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0.0`

[Max]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--fine_tune`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether finetuning should be performed to improve the resolution.
If set to True, an additional finetuning step is performed after initial classification,
new marker genes are calculated based on all cells with a score higher then the maximum score minus `--fine_tuning_thershold`,
and the calculation of the scores is repeated.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--fine_tuning_threshold`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The maximum difference from the maximum correlation to use in fine-tuning
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.05`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--prune`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether label pruning should be performed. If set to True, an additional output .obs field `--output_obs_pruned_predictions` will be added to the `--output`, containing labels where 'low-quality' labels are replaced with NA's. Labels are considered 'low-quality' when their delta score (stored in `--output_obs_delta_next`) fall more than 3 median absolute deviations below the median for that label type.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--sanitize_ensembl_ids`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to sanitize ensembl ids by removing version numbers.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::::

[Default]{.arg-key} `"singler_pred"`

:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_obs_probability`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
In which `.obs` slots to store the probability of the predicted labels.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"singler_probability"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_obs_delta_next`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
In which `.obs` slot to store the delta between the best and next-best score. If `--fine_tune True`, this is reported for scores after fine-tuning.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"singler_delta_next"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_obs_pruned_predictions`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
In which `.obs` slot to store the pruned labels, where low-quality labels are replaced with NA's. Only added if `--prune True`.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"singler_pruned_labels"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_obsm_scores`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
In which `.obsm` slot to store the matrix of prediction correlations at the specified quantile for each label (column) in each cell (row).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"singler_scores"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_compression`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"gzip"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"gzip"`, `"lzf"`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/annotate/singler/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/annotate/singler);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/annotate/singler/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
